newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET SLIPS WITH GASOIL BUT PREMIUMS UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET SLIPS WITH GASOIL BUT PREMIUMS UNCHANGED.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices slipped 75 cents a tonne lower with IPE gas oil but premiums for physical cargoes of jet above the screen were unchanged.
Jet cargo differentials were talked around $18.00 above the IPE for end August arrival, little changed from Tuesday levels.
Dealers said a possible movement of 80,000 tonnes from the Middle East Gulf to Europe had kept a lid on the market despite better demand for good quality diesel.

Forward swaps were also quiet and little changed. The fourth quarter this year held around $25.50 a tonne above the IPE while the first and second quarters next year talked $26.50 and $22.50 respectively.
